subject: Marketplace private offer: distributor carve-out and crediting approval
messages:
From: Laura Chen <laura.chen@resellco.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: Alan Park <alan.park@cloud-mktplace.com>
Date: Thu, 08 Jul 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Distributor carve-out and private offer crediting question

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks again for the demo last week — Acme's infrastructure team liked the latency profile. Procurement has one follow-up before we finalize the private offer on the marketplace: they need the channel margin carve-out and a clear statement of how credits / refunds get passed through to us (ResellCo) versus the downstream distributor.

Two quick asks: 
- Can Redwood confirm whether distributor-level carve-outs are supported for Azure private offers (we need the ability to route 2% to the distributor and 6% to ResellCo)?
- How are post-fulfillment credits handled (billing credits vs. marketplace refunds) and what documentation do you need from our side?

I've attached a short procurement note from Acme that lists invoicing contact and a sample PO (acme_po_sample.pdf).

Appreciate a short reply so we can keep the private offer timeline (targeting signature this week).

Best,
Laura Chen
Head of Partnerships, ResellCo
--
Attachments: acme_po_sample.pdf
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Laura Chen <laura.chen@resellco.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 08 Jul 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Distributor carve-out and private offer crediting question

Hi Laura —

Short answer: yes, we can support a two-tier channel carve-out for Azure private offers, but we need to lock the passback percentages on the private-offer metadata and document the post-fulfillment routing in the deal playbook.

What I'll do / what we need from you:
- I'll attach the spreadsheet with the suggested net/net allocation for this deal (see attached redwood_po_pricing_v3.xlsx). It shows a sample split: 6% reseller (ResellCo) / 2% distributor.
- Please confirm the distributor legal entity name and tax ID so Finance can generate the pass-through mapping.
- For credits: we support two flows — (A) marketplace-managed refunds that reduce our invoice to the buyer (typical) or (B) Redwood-issued credit notes that we route to the reseller. Acme should indicate which flow they prefer.

Next steps: once you confirm the distributor details and Acme's preference on crediting we can update the private offer and push to DocuSign. If acceptable I can also loop in Karthik for any listing/marketplace gating items.

Thanks —
Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
--
Attachments: redwood_po_pricing_v3.xlsx
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 08 Jul 2026 11:20:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Distributor carve-out and private offer crediting question (numbers)

Stephanie / Irene —

Reviewed Laura's ask and the attached spreadsheet. A few internal notes / proposals before we send formal language: 

1) Channel passback proposal (recommended):
   - ResellCo (downstream partner): 6% of list price (net to partner)
   - Distributor (regional): 2% of list price (pass-through)
   - Redwood retains the remainder.

2) Credits handling (recommended):
   - Default = marketplace refund (reduces Redwood invoice to Acme).
   - If ResellCo requests credits routed to them, require signed reseller acceptance and a statement of responsibility for downstream refunds. Finance will need reseller W-9 (or equivalent) and distributor invoice mapping.

3) Tax / billing: ensure we include language that reseller/distributor are responsible for any VAT/GST in their jurisdiction; Redwood issues the primary invoice to Acme.

If legal wants, we can stitch a short carve-out clause into the private-offer T&Cs and request distributor evidence via secured upload. Recommend we keep the public listing unchanged and put carve-out in the private-offer metadata and attached SOW.

Ben
Director, Marketplace Sales Operations
--
Attachments: (internal) pricing_notes_for_deals.docx
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Laura Chen <laura.chen@resellco.com>, Procurement <procure@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 08 Jul 2026 13:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Private offer routing & approval steps for Acme (action items)

Hi Laura / Acme procurement —

Thanks for the note. I'm Karthik on the Marketplace team; looping in Procurement to confirm a couple of gating items so we can finalize the private offer today: 

Action items for ResellCo / Acme: 
- Confirm distributor legal name and tax ID (required for pass-through mapping).
- Confirm preferred credit flow: marketplace refund or Redwood-issued credit routed to ResellCo.
- If you select Redwood-issued credits, please upload reseller W-9 (or local equivalent) and distributor invoice sample to the Drive link below.

Notes on timeline: once we have the items above we can: 
1) Update private offer metadata with carve-out percentages (visible to Acme only).
2) Push to DocuSign (expected ~30–60 minutes for signature).
3) After signature, we will provision the marketplace SKU and enable passback in the billing ledger.

Drive (secure upload): https://drive.redwood.com/drive/folders/po-ACME-2026-07
HubSpot: https://hubspot.com/deal/DEAL-ACME-2026-07

If you prefer a quick call to clear items, I can be available at 2pm PT.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Marketplace Program Manager, Redwood Inference
--

Thanks, all. Acme confirmed distributor details and prefers marketplace refund flow (route A). I've uploaded the distributor legal name + sample invoice to the Drive link and attached the signed reseller MSA for your records. We do not need Redwood-issued credits for this deal.

Quick summary: 
- Distributor: NorthWest Distribution, Inc. (tax id: 12-3456789)
- Crediting: marketplace-managed refunds (preferred by Acme)
- Reseller MSA: attached (reseller_carveout_term.docx)

Next step from your side: update private-offer metadata with the 6%/2% carve-out and route DocuSign link to Acme procurement. Let me know when the DocuSign is live and we'll route for signature.

Laura
Head of Partnerships, ResellCo
